detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Generate new 256-bit symmetric key
Store in mock provider
Retrieve succeeds with matching material

xrefdescription.para: K-LIFE-02 — Key rotation: ACTIVE → ROTATING → ACTIVE.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Generate new key, mark as ACTIVE
Rotate: old key → ROTATING, new key → ACTIVE
Both keys accessible during rotation window
After rotation complete, old key may be revoked

Acceptance:
Key revocation transitions key status to REVOKED
Revoked key is never returned for encryption
Revocation is idempotent

xrefdescription.para: K-LIFE-04 — Key recovery (optional, depends on recovery policy).

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
If recovery enabled: restore revoked key to ACTIVE (with admin approval)
If recovery disabled: revoked key remains REVOKED forever
Recovery audit-logged

xrefdescription.para: K-ERR-01 — Encryption failure with invalid key material.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Attempt encryption with invalid key (e.g., wrong size)
Must fail-closed (no silent fallback)
Return ENCRYPTION_FAILED error code

xrefdescription.para: K-ERR-02 — Decryption failure with corrupted ciphertext.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Attempt decryption with corrupted/truncated ciphertext
Must fail-closed (no partial decryption)
Return decryption error, never silent success

Acceptance:
Vault provider request times out
Return DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE error (fail-closed)
No retry storm; bounded backoff

xrefdescription.para: K-ERR-04 — HSM signing failure: no fallback to software.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
HSM sign operation fails (offline, authentication error, etc.)
Must NOT fall back to software signing
Return error; operation fails-closed

xrefdescription.para: K-PROV-01 — Vault provider: valid token, key fetch succeeds.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Vault provider initialized with valid token
Key fetch returns material
No timeouts, no auth errors

xrefdescription.para: K-PROV-02 — Vault provider: expired/missing token → error.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Vault token expired or not provided
Key fetch returns DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
No unauthorized access granted

xrefdescription.para: K-PROV-03 — HSM provider: slot unavailable → fail-closed.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
HSM PKCS#11 slot does not exist or is offline
Signing/key-gen returns error (not timeout, immediate fail-closed)
No fallback to software HSM

xrefdescription.para: K-PROV-04 — PKI provider: cert rotation maintains key-pair consistency.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Old cert used for signing transitions to new cert
Private key remains consistent across rotation
No gap where cert/key pair are mismatched

xrefdescription.para: Phase 2 Integration: Multi-key lifecycle under concurrent access.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Create 10 keys, rotate 5, revoke 2, recover 1
Access concurrently from 4 threads
All operations complete without race or lost updates
Audit trail captures all state transitions

briefdescription.para: Phase 2 security module crypto/key-management hardening focused tests.

detaileddescription.para: Validates key-lifecycle operations (create/rotate/revoke/recover) and cryptographic error-path handling across vault, HSM, and PKI providers.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: K-LIFE-01 Key creation: generate new symmetric key, store, verify retrieval. K-LIFE-02 Key rotation: transition old key to ROTATING, new key to ACTIVE. K-LIFE-03 Key revocation: mark key as REVOKED, verify deny on retrieval. K-LIFE-04 Key recovery: restore revoked key if recovery enabled, else deny.

K-ERR-01 Encryption failure (invalid key) → ENCRYPTION_FAILED (fail-closed). K-ERR-02 Decryption failure (corrupted ciphertext) → fail-closed denial. K-ERR-03 Key-provider timeout (Vault unavailable) → DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. K-ERR-04 HSM signing failure → fail-closed, no fallback to software signing.

K-PROV-01 Vault provider: key fetch with valid token succeeds. K-PROV-02 Vault provider: expired/missing token → DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. K-PROV-03 HSM provider: PKCS#11 slot unavailable → graceful fail-closed. K-PROV-04 PKI provider: certificate rotation under key-pair consistency.
